audience: kitchen managers and purchasers who run recipes and stock in Apicbase

useCases.title: Check the food cost of a recipe
useCases.text: Get one recipe with its yield and sell price. Then read its food cost and margin, for one outlet if you choose.

useCases.title: Find everything that contains an ingredient
useCases.text: Search the library for a text, such as butter. Then read one ingredient with its composition and allergen data.

useCases.title: Compare the supplier packages of a stock item
useCases.text: List the suppliers, then the supplier packages with their package size, article number and price.

useCases.title: Review the purchase orders of an outlet
useCases.text: List the purchase orders, filtered by supplier, outlet or status. Open one order to see its lines.

useCases.title: Check the waste recorded at an outlet
useCases.text: List the waste events of one outlet, one page at a time, to see the stock thrown away.
